name: Birdeye
tagline: Multi-chain on-chain market data for tokens, trades, wallets, and DeFi.
description: Birdeye Data Services (BDS) is a production crypto market-intelligence API covering real-time and historical token prices, OHLCV, liquidity, trades, pairs, holders, wallets/PnL, trending discovery, and security across Solana, Sui, and major EVM chains. Developers authenticate with an API key and call REST endpoints on public-api.birdeye.so (plus optional WebSockets on higher plans). Usage is metered in compute units (CUs) with tiered packages from free Standard through Enterprise.

auth.details: API key via X-API-KEY header (required). Self-serve signup at bds.birdeye.so; generate keys in Dashboard → Security. Most requests also send optional x-chain header (default solana).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Standard (free): 30,000 CUs/month, 1 rps; limited but substantial endpoint access (e.g. /defi/price, OHLCV, token list, token overview); no CU overage
pricing.paid_plans: Lite $39 (1.5M CUs, 15 rps); Starter $99 (5M CUs, 15 rps); Premium $199 (15M CUs, 50 rps + WebSockets); Business $499+ (60M–500M CUs, 100–150 rps); Growth/Enterprise custom. Overage billed per 1M CUs by tier.

rate_limits: Account-level (rps, with documented sustained rpm where listed): Standard 1 rps; Lite/Starter 15 rps; Premium 50 rps / 1000 rpm; Business 100 rps / 1500 rpm (higher Business tiers 150 rps per pricing); Growth AutoScale 150 rps / 9000 rpm; Enterprise custom. Wallet APIs (all packages, beta): 5 rps and 75 rpm. Some heavy endpoints have lower per-API caps.
use_cases: get latest USD price for a Solana or EVM token by address
fetch OHLCV candles for a token or trading pair
list or search tokens by liquidity, volume, or new listings
get wallet portfolio holdings and PnL on Solana
stream real-time price or trade updates via WebSocket (paid tiers)
pull top traders, holders, or gainer/loser leaderboards for a token
